R127 - Presentation 5.2 (boards) on gen7: the named rasters inside each arena's venue package
`rendering/stadium/stadium_<arenaartid>_container_<n>` (Studio joins arenaartid -> container on 100 % of rows, arena_assets.rs). Read-only.
Per container (RW4xb2 / RW4ps3, big-endian): file-table chunk-type census; the 0xEC0010 name dictionary (count word = flag byte 0x01 +
24-bit count on these packages; entries {u32 string abs offset | u32 type id | u32 object index}); every 0x20003 raster descriptor with its
dictionary name and (w, h, format) decoded as in R107 (X360: +35 format, +37 h, +38 w; PS3: signature words, +48 w, +50 h), and the SHA-256
of the descriptor bytes. Per tree: raster name classes (arena abbreviations and digits normalised to '#'), which classes carry an arena
token, and names shared by several containers (same name in >1 arena = a shared asset candidate; per-arena names = arena-specific art).
Correction during the run: on these packages the dictionary names materials (0xEF0005) and geometry groups (0xEB0000 / 0xEB0008), not
rasters, so classes are computed on MATERIAL names (Clone suffixes stripped) with each material's shader file name; rasters are counted by
size / format only (they are unnamed here). The material -> raster edge is not decoded (a constant word 2 in every material is not a raster
reference). Only the name / descriptor layer is read; payload bytes are not decoded or compared (sharing = name identity, not byte identity).
Usage: python r127_gen7_stadium_board_rasters.py <out.json>
